claim_boundary: C023 records twenty-four attacks. No attack is terminal. H138-H140 remain formalizing, under attack or open because exact certificate replay is finite and no asymptotic cached-calculus lower bound has been proved.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the certificate machine may differ from Policy-0A
attacks.method: Compare production and traced executions across 1,200 non-affine UNSAT formulas and structured fixtures, including answers, unique states, memo entries and local Resolution counters.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: producer and verifier may share one in-memory memo bug
attacks.method: Serialize only primitive call and state records; replay cache completion order, transitions and results independently and reject corrupted target, result, residual key and context certificates.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a cache edge may point forward or create a cyclic proof object
attacks.method: Traverse the residual-judgement DAG in DFS completion order and require every cache target to be completed before reuse; compute the exact unfolding recurrence without materializing duplicate subtrees.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: counting states and cache hits may hide dominant local proof work or canonicalization
attacks.method: Charge calls, states, branch edges, unit events and every local Resolution event; MAJ3-K4 already has 50,796 certificate records including 37,432 local resolvents.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: one cache-state clause may be assumed reusable in every decision context
attacks.method: Construct exact residual diamonds whose two visits have opposite decision boundaries while sharing one canonical residual key.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: every reused state may retain a large common decision clause
attacks.method: Profile all direct cache targets on MAJ3-K4; 438 reused states have opposite decision contexts and four have empty decision-boundary intersection.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a C022 conflict clause from one occurrence may serve every occurrence of the same residual
attacks.method: Unfold the entire exact-cache DAG, translate it by the C022 provenance mechanism, group all direct and inherited repeated-state occurrences, and compare emitted clauses against decision and full-entry intersections.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Boolean exact caching may be conflated with generalized reason learning
attacks.method: Compare JANUS-FC_local with the primary Formula-Caching taxonomy: Policy-0A stores an exact residual and Boolean answer but no returned context-independent reason or weakening rule.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: exact caching may restore the quadratic state envelope on the lifted Tseitin fixture
attacks.method: Run verified Policy-0A on MAJ3-K4: 2,427 unique residuals exceed the 1,296-state quadratic cap despite 888 cache hits.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Policy-0A local Resolution may make the historical basic-FC hard family trivial
attacks.method: Generate smart graph tautologies and measure states and local proof work through order size nine under an explicit state cap.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a basic Formula-Caching lower bound may be imported without simulating Policy-0A's local Resolution pass
attacks.method: Keep JANUS-FC_local distinct from historical basic FC until every bounded local resolvent is charged and the lower-bound invariant is proved robust under those additions.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: rapid growth in order size n may be mislabeled exponential in actual CNF length
attacks.method: Record variables, clauses, literal occurrences and an explicit encoding-unit count for each graph tautology; require every asymptotic claim to be restated in that length parameter.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the formula-caching interface may remain informal
attacks.method: H138 supplies exact state, call, event, cache-edge and independent replay syntax under the name JANUS-FC_local.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: finite cache savings may be mistaken for a polynomial universal SAT policy
attacks.method: Random small formulas showed no cache hits, MAJ3-K4 still exceeded a quadratic state envelope, and no polynomial worst-case theorem or witness-recovery bound was obtained.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the C022 no-cache lower bound may be silently transferred to Policy-0A
attacks.method: Measure a MAJ3 exact-cache DAG with 4,117 calls versus 15,671 unfolded occurrences; C022 applies only after unfolding and does not charge cache sharing directly.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the no-cache boundary-clause induction may immediately yield one clause per cache state
attacks.method: Group repeated residual occurrences under distinct decision and inherited-unit assignments and test whether emitted C022 clauses remain reusable without unfolding.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Formula caching may reactivate the visible affine dispatcher on MAJ3 lifts
attacks.method: Use the same exact MAJ3 encoding and affine-answer-none precondition; caching changes state reuse only after dispatch.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a tree proof simulation may count each unique residual only once
attacks.method: Exact unfolding shows cache edges duplicate entire descendant subtrees; a simulation must either pay all occurrences or provide a sound reusable reason rule.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the C021 finite trace-to-proof bridge may already cover memo hits
attacks.method: C021 has no cache inference; C023 exhibits identical residual keys under different contexts and retains H134 only as an unfolded-tree component.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: high treewidth alone may prevent exact residual convergence
attacks.method: MAJ3-K4 exhibits 888 exact cache hits despite a highly coupled lifted structure, so cache reuse and graph width must be analyzed separately.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: memoization may be treated as recovery of hidden affine structure
attacks.method: The affine dispatcher remains inactive; cache hits arise from exact syntactic residual equality and do not expose parity equations.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a cache DAG may be mistaken for a polynomial continuation quotient
attacks.method: Policy-0A stores only visited exact residuals; MAJ3-K4 already has 2,427 unique states and C020's exponential all-state quotient obstruction remains untouched.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: exact memoization may automatically satisfy the universal compiler-factorization target
attacks.method: JANUS-FC_local reuses only byte-identical residuals selected by one search policy and provides no universal transduction quotient or polynomial state bound.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Policy-0A may represent the whole bounded-pass compilation class
attacks.method: The exact policy has one branch rule, one local Resolution budget and exact memo keys; it does not contain arbitrary bounded-pass low-treewidth compilers.
